trace.question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
trace.evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to PLT <= 100 or PLT >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to PLT < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(PLT < 100), SUM(PLT > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to PLT > 400;

attempts.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_minus_higher
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

trace.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_minus_higher
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400
trace.answer: The query result shows a difference of -555, meaning there are 555 more patients with a higher-than-normal platelet level than with a lower-than-normal level.
